parameters.name: ArchitectureType
parameters.description:
The architecture of the instance. Valid values:

*   **cluster**: cluster architecture
*   **standard**: standard architecture
*   **rwsplit**: read/write splitting architecture

parameters.name: ChargeType
parameters.description:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

*   **PrePaid**: subscription
*   **PostPaid**: pay-as-you-go

parameters.name: EditionType
parameters.description:
The edition of the instance. Valid values:

*   **Community**: Redis Open-Source Edition
*   **Enterprise**: Tair (Enterprise Edition)

parameters.name: EngineVersion
parameters.description:
The engine version of the instance. Valid values: **2.8**, **4.0**, **5.0**, **6.0**, and **7.0**.

Valid values:

*   1.0
*   2.8
*   4.0
*   5.0
*   6.0
*   7.0

parameters.name: InstanceClass
parameters.description: The instance type of the instance. For more information, see [Instance types](~~107984~~).

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description:
The IDs of instances.

> By default, all instances that belong to this account are queried. If you specify multiple instance IDs, separate the instance IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: InstanceStatus
parameters.description:
The state of the instance. Valid values:

*   **Normal**: The instance is normal.
*   **Creating**: The instance is being created.
*   **Changing**: The configurations of the instance are being changed.
*   **Inactive**: The instance is disabled.
*   **Flushing**: The instance is being released.
*   **Released**: The instance is released.
*   **Transforming**: The billing method of the instance is being changed.
*   **Unavailable**: The instance is unavailable.
*   **Error**: The instance failed to be created.
*   **Migrating**: The instance is being migrated.
*   **BackupRecovering**: The instance is being restored from a backup.
*   **MinorVersionUpgrading**: The minor version of the instance is being updated.
*   **NetworkModifying**: The network type of the instance is being changed.
*   **SSLModifying**: The SSL certificate of the instance is being changed.
*   **MajorVersionUpgrading**: The major version of the instance is being upgraded. The instance remains accessible during the upgrade.

> For more information about instance states, see [Instance states and impacts](~~200740~~).

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The category of the instance. Valid values:

*   **Tair**
*   **Redis**
*   **Memcache**

parameters.name: NetworkType
parameters.description:
The network type of the instance. Valid values:

*   **CLASSIC**: classic network
*   **VPC**: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)

parameters.name: PrivateIp
parameters.description: The private IP address of the instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the instances you want to query reside. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~473763~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the instances you want to query belong.

> You can query resource group IDs by using the Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) console or by calling the [ListResourceGroups](~~158855~~) operation. For more information, see [View basic information of a resource group](~~151181~~).

parameters.name: SearchKey
parameters.description: The keyword used for fuzzy search. The keyword can be based on an instance ID or an instance description.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID of the instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore describe-instances-overview --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-ids r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --instance-status Normal --charge-type PostPaid --network-type CLASSIC --engine-version 6.0 --instance-class redis.master.small.default --vpc-id vpc-bp1nme44gek34slfc0000 --vswitch-id vsw-bp1e7clcw529l773d0000 --instance-type Redis --search-key apitest --architecture-type standard --zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --resource-group-id rg-acfmyiu4ekp0000 --edition-type Enterprise --private-ip 172.16.49.000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun r-kvstore DescribeInstancesOverview --region cn-hangzhou --ArchitectureType standard --EngineVersion '6.0' --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-b' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmyiu4ekp0000' --EditionType Enterprise --VSwitchId 'vsw-bp1e7clcw529l773d0000' --InstanceClass 'redis.master.small.default' --VpcId 'vpc-bp1nme44gek34slfc0000' --PrivateIp '172.16.49.000' --InstanceStatus Normal --ChargeType PostPaid --NetworkType CLASSIC --SearchKey apitest --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceIds 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000' --InstanceType Redis
